purpose: Aurora (aurora-model==0.2.0) unimodal zero-shot baseline on TimesX, aligned with EXP-004 (VisionTS Z0) frozen evaluation protocol.
declaration: Aurora is NOT trained or fine-tuned on TimesX. Pre-training data overlap is not audited, so no stronger claim is made.

data.window: past = series[s:s+96], target = series[s+96:s+108], s = variables[var_key].sample_start_idx[sample_id], test list = variables[var_key].native.test
data.window_key: (var_key, sample_id) composite key; uniqueness and all alignment checks use the composite key only

model.loading: custom wrapper: sha256 verify -> state_dict key bidirectional diff vs safetensors -> load_state_dict(strict=True) -> eval() -> all params requires_grad_(False); official load_model() not used (strict=False, no eval())

inference.itl_note: Main scheme itl=48 follows the official TimeMMD zero-shot precedent (Health/Traffic: seq_len=96, inference_token_len=48). itl=9 is a candidate pending verification; final freeze is a user decision, never inferred from token count alone.
inference.pred_reduction: mean over the 100-sample dim -> single point forecast (float64)

seeds.application: torch.manual_seed(w) immediately before each window's generate() call; no other RNG consumption between seeding and generate()

determinism.timing: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8' must be set in process env BEFORE any CUDA initialization; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False must all be applied BEFORE the first inference call.
determinism.error_policy: If a determinism error names a specific op, record the op and the disposition in the preflight report; never silently fall back to warn_only.

scoring.window_d: d = pstdev(past96, ddof=0); if d < 1e-8: d = fallback_std (precomputed in split_manifest per variable from first training sample past-96)
scoring.std_mse: mean(((pred - target)/d)^2) per window -> mean per variable -> equal weight within domain -> equal weight across 19 domains
scoring.std_mae: mean(|pred - target|/d) with the same aggregation ladder
scoring.d_vs_revin_note: The scoring denominator d (pstdev with fallback) and Aurora's internal RevIN scale (std(unbiased=False)+1e-5) are distinct quantities. Scoring uses only d; inference uses only the official revin path. They are never interchanged or blended. For small-scale sequences their difference can be material; no negligibility claim is made.
scoring.reference: VisionTS Z0 overall std-MSE 3.6547 / std-MAE 1.0491 at display precision only (not an equality target)

shard_fingerprint.resume_policy: On resume, every header field is re-verified against the current protocol; ANY mismatch -> shard is NOT reused, moved to quarantine/ (never deleted), and re-generated.
shard_fingerprint.done_marker: .done JSON with the same fingerprint is written only after atomic shard completion

outputs.npz_schema: sample_ids(int64)/var_keys(str)/domains(str)/pred(N,12 float64)/target(N,12 float64)/d(N, float64), sharded by (base_seed, domain), Z0-compatible
outputs.aggregate: domain MSE/MAE CSVs + 19-domain-equal-weight overall + seed mean/std (ddof=1) across the three base seeds; best seed is NEVER selected
outputs.coverage_check: key set equal to Z0__test.npz keys; target and d recomputed from frozen data and compared with stored values at exact equality (same frozen source)

eval_gate.runtime_checks: all sha256 fingerprints re-verified at startup; test window count == 2474; composite-key set equals Z0
eval_gate.status: implemented but NOT started in this round; requires explicit user approval
